name: BeeDocs
author: Bart Roelant
description: BeeDocs documentation library in the Omarchy bar: server status, full-text search, and a one-click workspace window.

barWidget.description: Watch the BeeDocs server, search the library from the bar, and open the workspace in its own window.

schema.label: BeeDocs URL
schema.description: Where the BeeDocs API + UI are served.

schema.label: Workspace URL
schema.description: Optional. Where windows open when the UI is served elsewhere than the API — e.g. http://localhost:5200 for the Vite dev stack. Empty = same as BeeDocs URL.

schema.label: API key
schema.description: Optional. Sent as X-Api-Key for instances with sign-in enabled (BeeDocs:ApiKey).

schema.label: BeeDocs checkout
schema.description: Optional. Enables the Start BeeDocs button (runs scripts/start.sh in a terminal) when the server is down.

schema.label: Start command
schema.description: Optional. Command that starts the server when it is down — e.g. 'systemctl --user start beedocs' for an installed instance. Takes precedence over the checkout's start.sh.

schema.label: Window pattern
schema.description: Hyprland class/title pattern used to focus an already-open BeeDocs window instead of launching a second one.
